name: rel
description: Browse, diagnose navigation failures, and build restartable crawlers with REL's persistent embedded Chromium sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Browse with persistent local Chromium sessions.
interface.longDescription: Control REL's app-owned Chromium sessions from Codex. Read pages, perform native browser actions, inspect non-blocking session diagnostics, export bounded debug bundles, and build restartable crawlers through the local MCP adapter. Available tools come from the installed REL app.
defaultPrompt: Capture this URL with REL and summarize the page.
Use my existing REL session to inspect the current page.
Design a restartable REL crawl for this website.
Diagnose the failed navigation in my REL Session using its trace and debug state.
